title: 第12章 你这么强，不阴怎么赢你啊
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
子时，寒月阁。

    林尘推门进去的时候屋里只点了一盏灯。

    玉玲珑侧身坐在床边，散着头发，穿了一件月白色的寝衣，薄薄的衣料被烛光映得微微泛黄。

    她听见他进来，偏过头看了他一眼，然后抬手布下一道隔音禁制。

    “过来。”

    林尘走到床边。

    她伸手扣住他的手腕，灵力探进去走了一圈，眉头微微皱起。

    “骨裂还没完全愈合。右臂经脉的拉伤也没好透。把衣服脱了。”

    林尘解开衣襟，赤着上身躺到玉床上。

    肋骨处的淤青已经从青紫色褪成了淡黄色，但她的手指按上去时还是传来一阵钝痛。

    玉玲珑从床头拿起白瓷药罐，挖了一团续骨膏在掌心里化开，俯身按在他肋间。

    药膏触到皮肤的瞬间是凉的，但她的掌心很热。

    十指蘸着药膏从他肋间一路抹到腰侧，指腹贴着皮肤缓缓打着圈。

    她抹药的动作很仔细，每一根肋骨都单独按压过去。

    手指在他第四根肋骨末端停住时，林尘的腹肌不由自主地绷了一下。

    “疼？”

    “不疼。师尊的手指有点凉。”

    “我的手指不凉。”

    她又在那根肋骨上压了一下，然后手指继续往下，在他腰侧停住。

    她的指尖在他腰侧的皮肤上轻轻划了一下，不是在抹药——是故意在画圈。

    “师尊。”林尘的声音有些不稳。

    “嗯？”

    “你刚才那个不是疗伤。”

    “怎么不是疗伤。”

    玉玲珑的声音依旧平淡，但手指又在他腰侧画了一圈，“续骨膏需要灵力化开才能渗进骨裂处，为师在用灵力帮你化药。你以为为师在做什么？”

    林尘没有回答。

    她又换了一处伤处，这回是右臂的虎口。

    她把他的手拉过来放在自己腿上，十指交扣握紧他的手掌，药膏在两人的掌心中被体温融化成温热的一片。

    她握着他的手，指尖在他虎口的裂伤处轻轻摩挲，灵力裹着药性一缕一缕渗进去。

    “师尊。”林尘的喉结动了一下。

    “又怎么了。”

    “你这次握的是手，不是虎口。”

    “手和虎口连着同一条经脉。”

    她的拇指在他虎口上缓缓按了一圈，“打通了这里，手臂的拉伤才好得快。你明天要打韩铮，右臂不能留任何隐患。”

    她松开他的手，站起来走到桌边，背对着他。

    烛光把她的侧影投在墙上，她抬手解开寝衣的第一颗纽扣，然后是第二颗。

    “接下来的疗伤需要去灵境空间。”

    林尘看着她的背影，嘴角微微翘了一下。

    “师尊，你上次也说是疗伤。”

    “上次确实是疗伤。”

    她转过身来，寝衣从肩头滑落，“这次也是。”

    灵境空间在黑暗中展开。

    脚下是透明的灵光地面，头顶是流转的星河。

    玉玲珑站在他对面，灵光在她的肩颈和腰肢上镀了一层柔和的光晕。

    她伸出手。

    “过来。”

    这一次的灵力引导比以往任何一次都更绵长，也更深入。

    她的灵力从丹田渡入他体内，裹着他经脉中残留的伤处缓缓温养。

    但这次不只是温养——她故意放慢了灵力流转的速度，让两人的气息在灵境空间中交缠了整整一个时辰。

    每当他的灵力快要跟不上时，她就用指尖在他掌心轻轻划一下。

    “你今天特别容易分心。”

    她的声音在他耳边响起，气息拂过他的耳廓。

    “师尊靠这么近，不分心才怪。”

    “那怪为师了？”

    “怪弟子定力不够。”

    她低低地笑了一声，手指从他掌心滑到手腕内侧，指尖在他脉搏上轻轻按了一下。

    “心跳这么快。看来灵力流转的强度还不够。”

    她收紧了两人交握的手指，灵力引导的强度骤然提升。

    林尘闷哼一声，体内的灵力像被点燃了一样疯狂流转。

    丹田深处的灵液湖泊在这股力量的冲击下开始加速凝聚，从液态向半固态转化。

    两个时辰后，灵境空间缓缓消散。

    两人重新回到黑暗中。

    林尘躺在床上，体内的灵力比来之前浓了至少三成——筑基中期的境界被夯实得如同磐石，丹田里的灵液湖泊已经开始凝出细小的晶体颗粒。

    骨裂处的隐痛完全消失了，右臂的拉伤也恢复了九成以上。

    “明天那把碎星拿到手，你的瞬身步才算真正配上兵器。”
content_en:
Zishi, Hanyue Pavilion.

    When Lin Chen pushed the door open and entered, there was only one lamp lit in the room.

    Yu Linglong was sitting sideways on the edge of the bed, with her hair loose and wearing a moon-white pajamas. The thin material was slightly yellowed by the candlelight.

    She heard him come in, turned her head and glanced at him, then raised her hand to set up a soundproofing ban.

    "Come here."

    Lin Chen walked to the bed.

    She reached out and clasped his wrist, her spiritual energy penetrated and walked around, frowning slightly.

    "The bone fracture hasn't completely healed yet. The strain on the meridians of my right arm hasn't healed yet. Take off your clothes."

    Lin Chen unbuttoned his clothes and lay on the jade bed with his upper body naked.

    The bruise on the ribs had faded from purple to light yellow, but there was still a dull pain when she pressed her fingers on it.

    Yu Linglong picked up the white porcelain medicine jar from the bedside, dug out a ball of bone-repairing ointment and melted it in her palm, then leaned over and pressed it between his ribs.

    The ointment was cool the moment it touched her skin, but her palms were warm.

    Dip your fingers into the ointment and apply it from his ribs to his waist, rubbing the pads of your fingers slowly in circles against the skin.

    She applied the medicine very carefully, pressing each rib individually.

    When his fingers stopped at the end of his fourth rib, Lin Chen's abdominal muscles tensed involuntarily.

    "It hurts?"

    "It doesn't hurt. Master's fingers are a little cold."

    "My fingers are not cold."

    She pressed on that rib again, then continued her fingers down, stopping at his waist.

    Her fingertips lightly scratched the skin on his waist, not applying medicine - but deliberately drawing circles.

    "Master." Lin Chen's voice was a little unsteady.

    "Huh?"

    "What you just did was not healing."

    "Why isn't it healing?"

    Yu Linglong's voice was still calm, but her fingers drew a circle around his waist, "The bone-extending ointment needs spiritual power to be melted before it can penetrate into the bone fracture. I am using my spiritual power to help you dissolve the medicine. What do you think I am doing?"

    Lin Chen did not answer.

    She changed the wound again, this time it was the tiger's mouth on her right arm.

    She pulled his hand over and placed it on her leg, interlocking her fingers and squeezing his palm. The ointment melted into a warm piece with their body temperature in their palms.

    She held his hand and gently rubbed her fingertips on the laceration of his tiger's mouth, and the spiritual energy wrapped in the medicinal properties seeped in strand by strand.

    "Master." Lin Chen's Adam's apple moved.

    "What's wrong?"

    "What you're holding this time is the hand, not the tiger's mouth."

    "The hand and the tiger's mouth are connected to the same meridian."

    She pressed her thumb slowly in a circle on his tiger's mouth, "The strain on your arm will heal faster after you get through this. You have to fight Han Zheng tomorrow, so there shouldn't be any hidden dangers in your right arm."

    She let go of his hand, stood up and walked to the table, her back to him.

    The candlelight cast her silhouette on the wall. She raised her hand to unbutton the first button of her pajamas, and then the second.

    "The next healing requires going to the spiritual space."

    Lin Chen looked at her back and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

    "Master, you said last time it was for healing."

    "Last time it was really healing."

    She turned around, her pajamas falling off her shoulders, "This time too."

    The spiritual space unfolds in the darkness.

    Under your feet is the transparent aura ground, and above your head are the flowing stars.

    Yu Linglong stood opposite him, and the spiritual light cast a soft halo on her shoulders, neck and waist.

    She held out her hand.

    "Come here."

    This time the spiritual guidance was longer and deeper than any before.

    Her spiritual power entered his body from his Dantian, wrapping the remaining wounds in his meridians and slowly warming them.

    But this time it wasn't just about nourishment - she deliberately slowed down the flow of spiritual power, allowing the two people's breaths to intertwine in the spiritual space for a full hour.

    Whenever his spiritual power was about to fail to keep up, she would lightly scratch his palm with her fingertips.

    "You're particularly easily distracted today."

    Her voice rang in his ears, and her breath brushed against his ears.

    "Master is so close, it would be strange not to be distracted."

    "Then the blame is the teacher?"

    "It's my fault that I don't have enough concentration."

    She gave a low laugh, slid her fingers from his palm to the inside of his wrist, and lightly pressed her fingertips on his pulse.

    "The heartbeat is so fast. It seems that the spiritual power flow is not strong enough."

    She tightened the fingers intertwined between the two of them, and the intensity of her spiritual guidance suddenly increased.

    Lin Chen groaned, and the spiritual power in his body circulated crazily as if it had been ignited.

    The spiritual liquid lake deep in the Dantian began to condense at an accelerated rate under the impact of this force, transforming from a liquid state to a semi-solid state.

    Two hours later, the spiritual space slowly dissipated.

    The two returned to the darkness.

    Lin Chen was lying on the bed, and the spiritual power in his body was at least 30% stronger than before - the realm of the middle stage of foundation building was as solid as a rock, and the lake of spiritual liquid in his Dantian had begun to condense into tiny crystal particles.

    The dull pain at the fractured bone completely disappeared, and the strain on his right arm was recovered by more than 90%.

    "When you get the broken star tomorrow, your teleportation step will be truly equipped with a weapon."
title_en: Chapter 12 You are so strong, how can I beat you if I don’t do it?
